answer: Each identity holds one registered coral-reef restoration plot: one reef patch, one diver, fragments grown on willow-wood frames. The diver tends it 180 days, logging growth against a crystal-tagged photo survey; the registry rejects a second claim on the patch, so one plot backs exactly one identity. Each fake costs one licensed diver, 900 units and 180 days underwater. 100 fakes cost 90,000 units, 100 divers, 18,000 dive-days. Cheapest cheat: renting a plot for 700 units a season, but the lender surrenders their own anchor, and a forged survey fails the tag and GPS check, burning both.
